```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(BPCells)
library(khroma)
library(harmony)
library(dreamlet)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
set.seed(501)
hypoad_ge = open_matrix_dir("./hypoad_prepro/hypoad_counts_bpcells_mat/")
hypoad_meta = readRDS("./hypoad_prepro/cell_metadata_hypoad_post_qc.rds")
donor_metadata = readRDS("./hypoad_prepro/donor_metadata_hypoad_post_qc.rds")
human_astro = hypoad_meta %>% filter(celltype== "Astrocyte")
human_astro = human_astro %>% filter(is_primary_data)
human_ge = hypoad_ge[,human_astro %>% rownames]

mouse_ge =open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
astro_mouse = non_neuronal_cluster_assignments[grepl("astrocyte-",non_neuronal_cluster_assignments)]
mouse_ge = mouse_ge[,names(astro_mouse)]
```

```{r}
library(babelgene)

ortho = orthologs(rownames(human_ge), species = "mouse", human = TRUE) %>%
  select(human_symbol, mouse_symbol = symbol) %>%
  filter(mouse_symbol %in% rownames(mouse_ge) & human_symbol %in% rownames(human_ge)) %>%
  distinct() 

one_to_one = ortho %>%   group_by(mouse_symbol) %>% filter(n() == 1) 
one_to_one = one_to_one  %>%   group_by(human_symbol) %>% filter(n() == 1) 

human_ge = human_ge[one_to_one$human_symbol,]
mouse_ge = mouse_ge[one_to_one$mouse_symbol,]

rownames(mouse_ge) = one_to_one$human_symbol

human_meta = human_astro %>% mutate(species = "human")
mouse_meta = data.frame(cell_id = colnames(mouse_ge), cluster = astro_mouse, species = "mouse")

human_meta$cluster = "astro"
human_meta = human_meta %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% select(cell_id, cluster, species)
joint_meta = rbind(human_meta, mouse_meta)

joint_ge = cbind(human_ge, mouse_ge)

```

harmony integration
```{r}
get_pcs_from_initial_dataset = function(initial_ge_matrix, n_var_genes = 2000, nthreads = 8, npcs = 30) {
  initial_ge_matrix <- multiply_cols(initial_ge_matrix, 1/Matrix::colSums(initial_ge_matrix))
  initial_ge_matrix <- log1p(initial_ge_matrix * 1e4) # Log transform
  #stats <- matrix_stats(initial_ge_matrix, row_stats="variance", threads = nthreads)
  # Variable Gene Selection Using Seurat VST 
  variable_genes <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(initial_ge_matrix, nfeatures = n_var_genes) 
  variable_genes = variable_genes %>% filter(variable == T) 
  variable_genes$gene = rownames(variable_genes)
  variable_genes$standard_deviation = sqrt(variable_genes$variance)
  gene_means <- variable_genes$mean
  gene_std <- variable_genes$standard_deviation
  initial_ge_matrix <- initial_ge_matrix[variable_genes$gene,]
  #write to disk before breaking sparsity via z-score
  preprocessed_ge = initial_ge_matrix %>% write_matrix_dir(tempfile("mat"), overwrite = T)
  #z-score
  preprocessed_ge <- (preprocessed_ge - gene_means) / gene_std
  #calculate 30 PCs 
  svd <- BPCells::svds(preprocessed_ge, k = npcs, threads = nthreads)
  pca <- multiply_cols(svd$v, svd$d)
  rownames(pca) = colnames(preprocessed_ge)
  colnames(pca) = paste("PC_",seq(1,ncol(pca)))
  return(pca)

}
pcs_astro = get_pcs_from_initial_dataset(joint_ge, n_var_genes = 5000)

#finds pcs after log normalization + z-scoring to get relative variance of gene in relation to distribution of that gene in the dataset
harmony_astro = RunHarmony(pcs_astro,meta_data = joint_meta$species)
```

-- update
```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(ranger)
library(glmnet)
library(recipes)
library(themis)
library(caret)
set.seed(501)

# --- align embedding with metadata -------------------------------------------
emb <- as.matrix(harmony_astro)
colnames(emb) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(ncol(emb)))
stopifnot(all(rownames(emb) == joint_meta$cell_id))

mouse_idx <- which(joint_meta$species == "mouse")
human_idx <- which(joint_meta$species == "human")

X_mouse <- emb[mouse_idx, , drop = FALSE]#embedding
y_mouse <- factor(joint_meta$cluster[mouse_idx])#cluster
X_human <- emb[human_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# --- 80/20 stratified train/test split ---------------------------------------
train_idx <- createDataPartition(y_mouse, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)[, 1]

X_train_raw <- X_mouse[train_idx, ]
y_train_raw <- y_mouse[train_idx]
X_test      <- X_mouse[-train_idx, ]
y_test      <- y_mouse[-train_idx]

# --- SMOTE balancing on training set only ------------------------------------
train_df <- as.data.frame(X_train_raw)
train_df$cluster <- y_train_raw

train_df_capped <- train_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5000) %>%
  ungroup()

smote_rec <- recipe(cluster ~ ., data = train_df_capped) %>%
  step_smote(cluster, over_ratio = 1) %>%
  prep()

train_balanced <- juice(smote_rec)
X_train <- as.matrix(train_balanced %>% select(-cluster))
y_train <- train_balanced$cluster

# --- XGBoost -----------------------------------------------------------------
y_levels    <- levels(factor(y_train))
y_train_int <- as.integer(factor(y_train, levels = y_levels)) - 1L

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train_int)

params <- list(
  objective   = "multi:softprob",
  num_class   = length(y_levels),
  eval_metric = "mlogloss"
)

cv_xgb <- xgb.cv(
  params  = params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  nfold   = 5,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params  = params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = cv_xgb$early_stop$best_iteration
)

P_xgb_test    <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = X_test)
xgb_test_pred <- factor(y_levels[max.col(P_xgb_test)], levels = levels(y_test))

# --- Random Forest (ranger) --------------------------------------------------
rf_model <- ranger(
  x = X_train,
  y = factor(y_train),
  classification = TRUE,
  seed = 501
)

rf_test_pred <- predict(rf_model, data = X_test)$predictions
rf_test_pred <- factor(rf_test_pred, levels = levels(y_test))

# --- Ridge GLMNet ------------------------------------------------------------
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_train, y = y_train,
  family = "multinomial", type.measure = "class",
  alpha = 0, nfolds = 5, parallel = FALSE
)

P_glm_test    <- drop(predict(cvfit, newx = X_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "response"))
glm_test_pred <- factor(colnames(P_glm_test)[max.col(P_glm_test)], levels = levels(y_test))

# --- Compare all three on held-out mouse test set ----------------------------
cm_xgb <- confusionMatrix(xgb_test_pred, y_test)
cm_rf  <- confusionMatrix(rf_test_pred,  y_test)
cm_glm <- confusionMatrix(glm_test_pred, y_test)

summary_df <- data.frame(
  model             = c("XGBoost", "Random Forest", "Ridge GLMNet"),
  accuracy          = c(cm_xgb$overall["Accuracy"],
                        cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"],
                        cm_glm$overall["Accuracy"]),
  kappa             = c(cm_xgb$overall["Kappa"],
                        cm_rf$overall["Kappa"],
                        cm_glm$overall["Kappa"]),
  balanced_accuracy = c(mean(cm_xgb$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"], na.rm = TRUE),
                        mean(cm_rf$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"],  na.rm = TRUE),
                        mean(cm_glm$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"], na.rm = TRUE))
)

print(summary_df)

# Per-class F1 for each model
f1_df <- data.frame(
  class     = rownames(cm_xgb$byClass),
  f1_xgb    = cm_xgb$byClass[, "F1"],
  f1_rf     = cm_rf$byClass[, "F1"],
  f1_glmnet = cm_glm$byClass[, "F1"]
)

print(f1_df)
```
Top performing class: xgboost, although astrocyte-5 has lowest f1 scores across all (prob because very rare)

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(recipes)
library(themis)
library(dplyr)
set.seed(501)

# 1. Combine mouse embeddings and labels into a single dataframe
mouse_df <- as.data.frame(X_mouse)
mouse_df$cluster <- y_mouse

# 2. Cap the maximum number of cells per cluster at 5000
# slice_sample(n = 5000) keeps exactly 5000 cells for large clusters, 
# and retains all cells for clusters with fewer than 5000.
mouse_df_capped <- mouse_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5000) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Build and prep a recipe to apply SMOTE
# By capping the majority class at 5000 first, step_smote (with over_ratio = 1) 
# will synthesize new cells for the smaller clusters until they also reach 5000.
smote_rec <- recipe(cluster ~ ., data = mouse_df_capped) %>%
  step_smote(cluster, over_ratio = 1) %>% 
  prep()

# Extract the fully balanced dataset
mouse_balanced <- juice(smote_rec)

# 4. Separate back into predictor matrix and target vector
X_mouse_sm <- as.matrix(mouse_balanced %>% select(-cluster))
y_mouse_sm <- mouse_balanced$cluster
```

xgboost
```{r}
library(xgboost)
set.seed(501)

# xgboost needs 0-indexed integer labels
y_levels   <- levels(factor(y_mouse_sm))
y_mouse_int <- as.integer(factor(y_mouse_sm, levels = y_levels)) - 1L

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_mouse_sm, label = y_mouse_int)

params <- list(
  objective   = "multi:softprob",
  num_class   = length(y_levels),
  eval_metric = "mlogloss"
)

# 5-fold CV to pick the number of rounds
cv <- xgb.cv(
  params  = params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  nfold   = 5,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20
)

best_n <- cv$early_stop$best_iteration

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params  = params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_n
)

# 6. Predict for human astrocytes
P_xgb <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = X_human)
colnames(P_xgb) <- y_levels
rownames(P_xgb) <- rownames(X_human)

human_xgb_classes<- y_levels[max.col(P_xgb, ties.method = "first")]
names(human_xgb_classes) = P_xgb %>% rownames
```

```{r}
library(sccomp)
rna_and_pmi_info = read_csv("./hypoad_prepro/rna and pmi donor info.csv")
rna_and_pmi_info = rna_and_pmi_info[1:14,]
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format= rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format %>% as.character()
#from stack overflow
rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal = 
sapply(strsplit(rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_format,":"),
  function(x) {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    x[1]+x[2]/60
    }
)

donor_metadata$pmi_hours = rna_and_pmi_info$pmi_hours_decimal[match(donor_metadata$donor_id, rna_and_pmi_info$cell_meta_id)]
donor_metadata$pmi_hours = scale(donor_metadata$pmi_hours)

# --- donor-level metadata with recoded ad variable ---------------------------
donor_info <- donor_metadata %>%
  select(donor_id, condition, age, pmi_hours) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(ad = case_when(
    condition %in% c("AD", "AD_44") ~ "ad",
    condition == "CTL"              ~ "ctl"
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ad)) %>%
  mutate(ad = factor(ad, levels = c("ctl", "ad")),
         donor_id = paste0("donor_", donor_id) %>% as.factor())
  
#scale age
donor_info$age = scale(donor_info$age)

# --- cell-to-donor link ------------------------------------------------------
cell_donor <- hypoad_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Astrocyte", is_primary_data) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  mutate(donor_id = paste0("donor_", donor_id) %>% as.factor()) %>%
  select(cell_id, donor_id)

cell_donor$astrocyte_mapped_cluster = human_meta$xgb_prediction[match(cell_donor$cell_id,human_meta$cell_id)]

cell_donor = cell_donor %>% left_join(donor_info, by = "donor_id")

# --- formula and contrasts ----------------------------------------------------
sccomp_formula <- as.formula("~ ad + age + pmi_hours")

contrasts_list <- list(
  "ad_vs_ctl" = "adad"
)


cluster_counts <- cell_donor %>%
  group_by(donor_id, astrocyte_mapped_cluster) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(donor_id, astrocyte_mapped_cluster, fill = list(count = 0))

cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% left_join(donor_info, by = "donor_id")

model <- cluster_counts %>%
  sccomp_estimate(
    formula_composition = sccomp_formula,
    sample     = "donor_id",
    cell_group = "astrocyte_mapped_cluster",
    abundance  = "count",
    bimodal_mean_variability_association = TRUE
  )
model <- model %>% sccomp_remove_outliers(percent_false_positive = 10)

contrast_formula = "adad"
contrast_result <- model %>%
    sccomp_test(contrast_formula, test_composition_above_logit_fold_change = 0)
contrast_result$contrast <- "ad"
```



```{r}
library(voomCLR)
library(limma)

voomclr_formula <- as.formula("~ age + ad + pmi_hours")

# cluster = rows, donor = cols
counts_wide <- cluster_counts %>%
  select(astrocyte_mapped_cluster, donor_id, count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor_id, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "astrocyte_mapped_cluster")

# design matrix — one row per donor, ordered to match columns
meta <- cluster_counts %>%
  distinct(donor_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(match(donor_id, colnames(counts_wide)))

design_mat <- model.matrix(voomclr_formula, data = meta)
colnames(design_mat) <- make.names(colnames(design_mat))

# voomCLR
v <- voomCLR(counts_wide, design = design_mat, varCalc = "analytical")
fit <- lmFit(v, design_mat)

# contrast: ad - ctl
contrasts <- makeContrasts(ad_vs_ctl = adad, levels = design_mat)
contFit <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrasts)
contFit <- eBayes(contFit)

voomclr_results <- topTableBC(contFit, coef = 1, n = Inf,
                 bootstrap = "parametric",
                 voomWeights = v$weights,
                 contrastMatrix = contrasts[, 1, drop = FALSE],
                 adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "ad_vs_ctl")

```


```{r}
library(ANCOMBC)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)

count_mat <- cluster_counts %>%
  select(astrocyte_mapped_cluster, donor_id, count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = donor_id, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("astrocyte_mapped_cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

meta_df <- cluster_counts %>%
  distinct(donor_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("donor_id")
meta_df <- meta_df[colnames(count_mat), ]
meta_df$ad <- relevel(factor(meta_df$ad), ref = "ctl")

tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = count_mat),
  colData = meta_df
)

out <- ancombc2(
  data        = tse,
  assay_name  = "counts",
  fix_formula = "ad + age + pmi_hours",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  verbose     = FALSE
)
term_name = "adad"
ancombc_results <- out$res %>%
  select(taxon,
         lfc = starts_with("lfc_adad"),
         se  = starts_with("se_adad"),
         p_val = starts_with("p_adad"),
         q_val = starts_with("q_adad")) %>%
  mutate(cluster  = taxon,
         contrast = "ad_vs_ctl") %>%
  select(cluster, contrast, lfc, se, p_val, q_val)
```


```{r}
# --- collect and standardise across all 3 frameworks -------------------------

# sccomp
sccomp_collected <- contrast_result %>%
  mutate(
    framework   = "sccomp",
    cluster     = astrocyte_mapped_cluster,
    direction   = ifelse(c_effect > 0, "up", "down"),
    adj_p_val   = c_FDR,
    raw_p_val   = NA_real_
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, contrast, framework, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)

# voomCLR
voomclr_collected <- voomclr_results %>%
  mutate(
    framework   = "voomclr",
    direction   = ifelse(logFC > 0, "up", "down"),
    adj_p_val   = adj.P.Val,
    raw_p_val   = P.Value
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, contrast, framework, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)

# ANCOM-BC2
ancombc_collected <- ancombc_results %>%
  mutate(
    framework   = "ancombc2",
    direction   = ifelse(lfc > 0, "up", "down"),
    adj_p_val   = q_val,
    raw_p_val   = p_val
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, contrast, framework, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)

combined_results <- bind_rows(sccomp_collected, voomclr_collected, ancombc_collected)

saveRDS(combined_results, "combined_compositional_results_human_astro.rds")

# --- consensus: significant in >= 2 of the 3 frameworks ----------------------
#set NAs to 1 below (not significant if not reported, relevant to sccomp but won't change anything)

combined_results = readRDS("combined_compositional_results_human_astro.rds")
sig_at_least_2 <- combined_results %>%
  select(-contrast) %>% #all contrasts same
  mutate(raw_p_val = case_when(
    is.na(raw_p_val) ~ 1,
    .default =  raw_p_val
  )) %>% 
  filter(raw_p_val < .1 | adj_p_val < .1) %>% 
  mutate(passed = T) %>% 
  group_by(cluster, direction, passed) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#plot astro-5 + astro_marker_map_xgb

#sccomp p

library(ggsignif)

astro5_star <- case_when(
  astro5_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
  astro5_p < 0.01  ~ "**",
  astro5_p < 0.05  ~ "*",
  astro5_p < 0.1   ~ "†",

        annotations = annotations,
        y_position  = y_position),
      manual      = TRUE,
      textsize    = 5,
      vjust       = .3,
      tip_length  = 0.02,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of Cells Mapped to Astrocyte-5") +
```

Plot mouse astro cluster above
```{r}
#clean animal metadata
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../shared objs and code/YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)
#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)


#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]


#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

#load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
neuronal_names  = names(neuronal_cluster_assignments)
#append neuronal to show the class
neuronal_cluster_assignments = paste0("neuronal-",neuronal_cluster_assignments)
names(neuronal_cluster_assignments) = neuronal_names
cluster_assignments = c(non_neuronal_cluster_assignments, neuronal_cluster_assignments)

#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

#Remove the single animal w/o CFC/CFA measurements (could be potential confound)
animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm = animal_metadata %>% filter(is.na(CFM) | is.na(CFA)) %>% pull(animal_id) %>% unique %>% as.character
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)

#identify animals with less than 1000 cells and remove them from dataset (low number of cells for an animal may throw off proportions)
animals_less_1000_cells = cell_metadata$animal_id %>% table %>% .[. < 1000] %>% names
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animals_less_1000_cells)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% droplevels()

#remove tcells since only one cluster
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(cluster != "tcells")

# Split  on cell class
cell_metadata$cell_class <- sub("[-_].*", "", cell_metadata$cluster)

#Identify classes with only one cluster (remove from proportion analysis)
classes_one_cluster = cell_metadata %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(cluster, cell_class) %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::count(cell_class) %>% filter(n == 1) %>% pull(cell_class)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!cell_class %in% classes_one_cluster) %>% droplevels()
# Split the cluster assignments into a list by cell class
cluster_list <- split(cell_metadata, cell_metadata$cell_class)

#convert animal_id to factor, to use to add metadata later 
animal_metadata$animal_id = as.factor(animal_metadata$animal_id)


#change young to 6 and old to 14 in age
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "young" ~ "6",
  animal_metadata$age == "old" ~ "14",
  .default = NA
)

cluster_counts_per_class = vector(mode = "list", length = length(cluster_list))
names(cluster_counts_per_class) = names(cluster_list)

for(i in seq_along(cluster_list)) {
  cur_class = names(cluster_list)[i]
  #initialize df to count cluster counts
  cluster_counts = cluster_list[[cur_class]] %>% ungroup()
  #convert columns to factor
  cluster_counts$cluster = as.factor(cluster_counts$cluster)
  cluster_counts$animal_id = as.factor(cluster_counts$animal_id)
  cluster_counts$age = as.factor(cluster_counts$age)
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(cluster, animal_id, .drop = F) %>% dplyr::count(name = "count")
  #add other columns back
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")
  #convert columns to factor
  cluster_counts$genotype = as.factor(cluster_counts$genotype)
  cluster_counts$strain = as.factor(cluster_counts$strain)
  cluster_counts$sex = as.factor(cluster_counts$sex)
  cluster_counts$age = as.factor(cluster_counts$age)
  #add "animal_" and "cluster_" to relevant columns to avoid problems with sccomp
  #cluster_counts$animal_id = paste0("animal_", cluster_counts$animal_id) %>% as.factor()
  #cluster_counts$cluster = paste0("cluster_", cluster_counts$cluster) %>% as.factor()
  #relevel to get the following as reference: genotype - Ntg, age - 6, sex - M
  cluster_counts$genotype = relevel(cluster_counts$genotype, ref = "Ntg")
  cluster_counts$age = relevel(cluster_counts$age, ref = "6")
  cluster_counts$sex = relevel(cluster_counts$sex, ref = "Male")
  cluster_counts$strain = relevel(cluster_counts$strain, ref = "B6")
  #ungroup the data to avoid problems with sccomp
  cluster_counts = cluster_counts %>% ungroup()
  cluster_counts_per_class[[cur_class]] = cluster_counts
}
```

Get relative astrocyte cluster proportions per animal
```{r}
astro_counts = cluster_counts_per_class$astrocyte
astrocyte_proportions = astro_counts %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(animal_id, .drop = F) %>%
  mutate(total_cells = sum(count)) %>% # Total cells *within the class*
  mutate(proportion = count/total_cells)
```
